name: dogfood-vector-search-app
description: Dogfood app (v1.26-4) — a SvelteKit + Kysely + Postgres 16 pgvector + Redis embedding cache app that exercises 4 patterns (IVFFlat / HNSW index build with dimension guard / semantic k-NN search with cosine + L2 distance / hybrid semantic + BM25 keyword search with tunable weight / embedding cache hit-rate observation with on-demand re-index) driven by @kiwa-lab/orm's vector-store semantics in KIWA_MODE=mock and testcontainers Postgres 16 + pgvector + Redis 7 in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip VECTOR_KEY). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/orm @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
